title: Missing and dead scientists: Loureiro, Gilmore, McCasland
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Missing and dead scientists: Loureiro, Gilmore, McCasland, about recent at MIT; Caltech; Wright-Patterson AFB, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: cases people are talking about Nuno Lorero who basically ran MIT's plasma fusion lab.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions cases people are talking about in which scientists have gone missing or died, naming Nuno Loureiro, who Michels says basically ran the plasma fusion lab at MIT, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, along with Carl Gilmore and Neil McCasland, with links to Caltech, the California Institute of Technology, and Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. Michels presents these as cases being discussed together, suggesting some people suspect a connection to sensitive research.
